messages:
Jasmine: Quick weekly check-in for Atlas Health — saw a notable tokens + throughput bump this week, want to flag before the EOW renewal touch.
Evan: Thanks — numbers?
Jasmine: WoW tokens: +32% (350k -> 462k). QoQ growth steady at +18%. Avg token size up ~15% (longer prompts).
Priya: Latency update: p95 went from 108ms to 120ms last 24h, p99 unchanged. Most requests still within SLO but tail moving.
Nikhil: Error rates? 5xx? Timeouts?
Jasmine: 5xx spiked to 0.9% this morning from 0.3% baseline. Mostly transient model timeouts + a couple backend 502s around 09:10 UTC. cs-bot posted Autoscaler events.
cs-bot: [automated] 2024-10-24T09:10:11Z autoscaler: scale-up started for dedicated-pool-atlas (requested +2 GPUs).
Evan: Spend impact?
Jasmine: Weekly spend +27% vs last week; burn rate increase aligns with tokens + longer responses. Renewal risk = medium if trend continues.
Priya: I pulled traces for 09:05-09:20. A burst of long-context requests triggered larger batch sizes -> spike in queueing. Suggest temporary per-route concurrency cap.
Nikhil: Agree. Recommend set max_concurrency=20 for /v1/generate route for Atlas until we patch batching thresholds.
Jasmine: Can we do that as a config change today? Also I'd like the enablement team to run a quick prompt-sizing session with the customer — many long prompts seem unneeded.
Evan: Ops: I can apply the concurrency cap now and enable a short window of verbose tracing for 2 hours. Will monitor.
